svg.aria-label: dsh-budget structure: usage arrives after the fact on session/event, converts in-process to cost, carbon and latency, lands in a three-scope gate ledger (session / daily / monthly), hands off to the alert / block / degrade disposition, and a blocked scope short-circuits the next llm/stream call; the dashed return rail closes the loop
svg.title: dsh-budget: one usage stream, three scoped gates, a pre-flight stop
